item.title: 智能体可靠性与评估：曾因糟糕评估而吃亏的企业最有可能将人类从流程中移除
item.summary: Across 108 enterprises, trust in automated agent evaluation rose sharply in July — and the failure rate it is supposed to predict did not move at all.
